full_judgment: A. T. M. AFZAL, C. J: The trial in connection with Lalbagh P. S. Case No. 33 (3) 92 under section 143/323/448/353/ 379 of the Penal Code was concluded and 25.9.1993 was fixed for judgment. The Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka noted in his order of the same date that it appeared that a counter case being Lalbagh P. S. Case No. 34(3) 92 was pending in his Court and examination of witness was going on and as such it was desirable that the two trials ought to have been held analogously. In the circumstances, he considered it Proper for fixing the date of delivery of judgment of both the case on the same day and accordingly stayed further proceeding of case No. 33 till the other Case No. 34 reached the stage of judgment. It was then ordered that the date of judgment in ease No. 33 be fixed on the date of judgment of Case No. 34.
